idea: Tilted-band long shot: lay out the k×k grid but replace one row (or column) with k+1 squares rotated by a small angle θ, stacked as a tilted chain in a strip of height slightly above 1/k. Shrink the other rows accordingly, then optimise θ, the strip height and the side lengths numerically with exact separating-axis feasibility checks. This targets n = k²+1-type values where a lattice cannot fit the extra square.
